info.title: Leave Management API (Pencatatan Cuti Bumblebee)
info.description:
API specification for the Leave Management (Pencatatan Cuti) backend.

Multi-tenant (company-scoped) application with a separate Platform (super-admin) area.

**Authentication** is cookie-based (httpOnly JWT, HS256, 8h expiry):
- Company users: cookie `hr_management_token` (payload: `sub`, `companyId`)
- Platform users: cookie `hr_platform_token` (payload: `sub`, `type: 'platform'`)

**Authorization** is permission-key based:
- Company routes: `authMiddleware` + `requirePermission(key)` -> 403 body includes `permission`
- Platform routes: `platformAuthMiddleware` + `requirePlatformPermission(key)` -> 403 body includes `requiredPermission`

**Tenant scope** always comes from the authenticated user's company (no tenant header/query).

**Response envelope** (all endpoints):
- Success: `{ "success": true, "message"?: string, "data"?: object }`
- Error: `{ "success": false, "message": string }`

Dates are ISO-8601 strings; date-only values (leave start/end, holidays) are sent and returned as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

servers.description: Local development server (PORT env, default 3000). All routes are mounted under /api.

NotFound.description: Resource not found (in the caller's tenant).

AuthPermission.description: Permission object returned in the auth payload (no description).

AuthUser.description: Company user session payload returned by /auth/login and /auth/me (`data.user`).

permissions.description: Effective permissions (role permissions merged with direct user permissions; DENY removes; Owner gets all).

PlatformAuthUser.description: Platform user session payload returned by /platform/auth/login and /platform/auth/me.

CompanyModuleCatalogItem.description: Module catalog entry normalized against the company's CompanyModule row.

employmentDate.description: Employment start date. Drives annual leave entitlement (1 year of service required).

level.description: Authority level. The system `owner` role has level 1000. Non-owner actors cannot create/update roles with level >= their own highest role level.

canDelegate.description: Whether the delegate may further delegate this authority.

actorUserId.description: The authenticated user who requested the list.

needsException.description: True when the request overlaps other employees' leave AND is adjacent to an active company holiday (exception workflow required).

totalDays.description: Computed working days (Mon-Fri excluding active company holidays), inclusive of start and end dates.

leavePeriodStart.description: Start of the employee's annual leave period (anniversary-to-anniversary). Equals startDate for non-ANNUAL types.

entitlement.description: Annual leave entitlement by completed years of service (settings: HAK_CUTI_1_TAHUN=7, HAK_CUTI_2_TAHUN=10, HAK_CUTI_3_TAHUN=12).

usedDays.description: Sum of APPROVED ANNUAL requests in the current period.

pendingDays.description: Sum of PENDING_MANAGEMENT/PENDING_OWNER ANNUAL requests in the current period.

eligible.description: Only present in the not-eligible fallback response (employee with < 1 year of service).

message.description: Only present in the not-eligible fallback response.

ApprovalDecision.description: Decision body for all leave approval endpoints.

post.description: The actor delegates one of their own permissions to a delegate user, optionally scoped to a target user or target role (not both). The actor becomes delegatorUserId. Validations enforce manage-ability, level rules, and that the actor holds (or is Owner with) the permission.

delegateUserId.description: Active user in the same company.

targetUserId.description: Scope: single target user. Mutually exclusive with targetRoleId. Omit both for a global delegation.

targetRoleId.description: Scope: all members of a role. Cannot target the Owner role.

post.description: Validates working days, minimum notice (setting MIN_HARI_PENGAJUAN, default 7 days before), maximum duration (setting MAX_HARI_CUTI, default 3 working days), annual leave entitlement/period, same-employee overlap, and company-wide overlap (overlap adjacent to an active holiday triggers the exception workflow). Created with status PENDING_MANAGEMENT and an approval record.

post.description: Stage 1 of the workflow. The actor must NOT be the owner. Self-approval is never allowed. APPROVE moves the request to PENDING_OWNER; REJECT ends it as REJECTED (owner stage SKIPPED).

post.description: Stage 2 of the workflow. Actor must be the company owner. Requires management APPROVED and status PENDING_OWNER. If the request needs an exception, the exception must already be APPROVED.

post.description: Decides the holiday-adjacency/overlap exception before the final owner stage. Actor must be the company owner. APPROVED keeps the request in PENDING_OWNER awaiting the owner decision; REJECTED also rejects the whole request.
